description: TfL publishes a companion directionality layer for its lane-rental application. The source identifies the 2021 tidal-directionality indicator, and the polyline schema contains Section_ID and IN_OUT_DIR. The metadata binds it to a named TfL lane-rental application. Direction codes were not interpreted from actual records, so their operational meaning needs checking before use. This is a companion control attribute layer, distinct from the full lane-rental network. Coverage is Greater London. Access is through the published ArcGIS feature service. Licence and cost: The item metadata does not state a reuse licence. Caveats: only item, service and layer metadata were inspected. No feature records were downloaded, and current completeness, geometric quality and operational availability remain untested. Access charges are not stated in the inspected metadata. The resource provides planning or policy-area inputs; applying it in a simulation requires checking the source limits and relevant model assumptions. Related resources include the existing TfL 2023 PTAL grid.
